_comment: FICTIONAL demo household. Not real people, accounts or addresses. The one source of truth for the demo papers (frontend/scripts/make-demo-papers.mjs) and the tests that check what each paper extracts (tests/test_demo_papers.py). The deliberate conflict: in the chat Maya says 2 people live with her; her household paper lists 3 (her mother Rosa, 60+).
